description: This file implements a simple FastCGI server used for unit testing. It handles FastCGI requests, processes specific query strings, and responds with hard-coded HTTP responses. The code manages socket communication, FastCGI protocol headers, and request processing logic.

methods.name: int sock_nb_set(SOCKET fd,unsigned int nb)
methods.description: Sets the socket to non-blocking mode (Windows-specific implementation).

methods.name: void fcgi_header(FCGI_Header * const header,const unsigned char type,const int request_id,const int contentLength,const unsigned char paddingLength)
methods.description: Constructs a FastCGI header with specified parameters.

methods.name: void fcgi_unknown_type_rec(FCGI_UnknownTypeRecord * const rec,const int req_id,const unsigned char type)
methods.description: Creates a FastCGI record for unknown request types.

methods.name: void fcgi_end_request_rec(FCGI_EndRequestRecord * const rec,const int req_id,const uint32_t appStatus,const unsigned char protocolStatus)
methods.description: Fills out a FastCGI end request record structure.

methods.name: int fcgi_puts(const int req_id,const char * const str,size_t len,FILE * const stream)
methods.description: Sends data over FastCGI stdout, handling fragmentation according to protocol limits.

methods.name: const char * fcgi_getenv(const unsigned char * const r,const uint32_t rlen,const char * const name,int nlen,int * len)
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FastCGI record buffer.

methods.name: int fcgi_process_params(FILE * const stream,int req_id,int role,unsigned char * const r,uint32_t rlen)
methods.description: Processes FastCGI request parameters and writes appropriate responses.

methods.name: int fcgi_dispatch_packet(FILE * stream,ssize_t offset,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Dispatches a received FastCGI packet based on its type.

methods.name: ssize_t fcgi_recv_packet(FILE * const stream,ssize_t sz)
methods.description: Receives and processes FastCGI packets from the stream.

methods.name: int fcgi_recv(const SOCKET fd,FILE * const stream)
methods.description: Main loop for receiving FastCGI requests over socket/file descriptor, calling dispatch appropriately.

methods.name: int main(void)
methods.description: Entry point for the FastCGI server simulation, handling platform-specific socket initialization and request processing.
